svg.text: Each is the card cut from the page, 358 pt wide, as it is on an iPhone. The chips stay where they are in every state.
A. Not a repository: no Where chip. A runtime
chosen by name, and its Account chip (two accounts)
B. Starting: the words held, the spinner,
Rework the new-session layout for the iPhone
C. The runtime is out: said once above the words,
and a dot on its chip; Send still sends
Claude’s plan is spent until 3:00 pm. It will say no until then.
D. The folder's host is not answering: the strip,
Your Mac is not answering. Waiting for it.
E. A persona picked: its choices in the chips, its labels
as tags after ⋯, and ⋯ counts what is set in More
F. Set by the organisation: a lock on the chip; it opens,
Permission mode and Sandbox are set by your organisation.
G. A picture attached that the runtime does not take:
refused before sending, in the runtime's name
H. Voice mode on: the first words start the session;
I. Auto picks nothing: the chip says so with a red dot,
No runtime can start now: Claude is out, Codex is not signed in.
